t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The number of mushrooms achieved is dependent on the colour of the gnome chosen. Each gnome comes in a pair of colours (i.e red and yellow.) If a gnome is chosen and you get 3 or less mushrooms, don't choose that gnome next time. If it provides 5 or more, continue with that colour. Know that the colour which provides more mushrooms may change in the middle of the game so stay focused.

vb_textbox.text: First things first, remember that you can mash the space bar as soon as you select a gnome so you never miss a basket QTE.Second, know that the colour of the gnome indicates how many mushrooms you will get from the basket. Each gnome will come in a pair of colours (e.g red and yellow or purple and maroon.) One gnome will provide more mushrooms than the other. Excluding multipliers, it works on a scale on 1-9. At the start of each round, find out which of the pair provides more mushrooms and continue to pick that one until you reach a break. Generally, a gnome which provides a non-multiplied 4+ mushrooms (i.e final score divided by multiplier is over 4) is the one which provides more mushrooms.Third, the colours which provides more mushrooms are usually similiar (i.e the more blue-oriented ones or the more red-oriented ones.) Use that to identify which colour is the best.Fourthly, remember that you can watch a youtube video or something similiar in the background. The task is long and repetitive so something to keep you somewhat entertained goes a long way to helping you make it to the end.Have fun.
